items.headline: Albemarle Stock Slides 28% in 3 Months: Should You Buy the Dip?
items.snippet: Albemarle expects lithium demand to grow at a 10-20% CAGR from 2025-2030, with stationary storage a significant driver. Demand growth this year trending near the higher end of a 15-40% range.

items.headline: Albemarle to Benefit From Low-cost Assets, Brownfield Opportunity, RBC Says
items.snippet: RBC Capital Markets said Albemarle will likely benefit from low-cost assets, brownfield opportunity, and continued focus on earnings improvement in Specialties. RBC has an outperform rating and decreased the price target to $157 from $166.

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $225 from $245 at Truist
items.snippet: Truist analyst Peter Osterland lowered the price target on Albemarle to $225 from $245 and keeps a Buy rating, citing cost efficiencies and capital discipline supporting strong free cash flow potential.

items.headline: Albemarle Corporation - Albemarle Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results
items.snippet: 2026 outlook: sales volumes expected 225-235 kilotons LCE, as increased Wodgina volumes partially offset a delay in the Talison CGP3 ramp due to a June 9 fire.
